passed_scope: Analytical-input/source consistency only. This flag does not certify part geometry, strength, service stiffness or the whole machine.
analysis_type: Closed-form box-beam, shear, strip and slat sensitivities; not FEA.

material_assumptions.interpretation: EffectiveE is rawE×0.75. This is an assumed stiffness reduction, not a qualified glue efficiency or plywood grade.
material_assumptions.web_credit: Seven modeled; five inner webs credited. All eight half-lap bands use skin-only composite bending I and reduced-web shear integration as a nominal sensitivity. Actual local coupling and joint compliance are unqualified. End grips preserve internal webs. Holes and adhesive durability still need physical verification.
no_stiffness_credit: Mechanical latches acting as a bonded laminate

local_top_skin.scope: Conservative25mm-wide strip with a midpoint point force. Actual plate distribution, grain and notch stresses are not qualified.

half_lap_effects.scope: Nominal piecewise unit-load sensitivity. It assumes composite skin coupling across the lap bands and an effective reduced-web shear path. Local notch/Vierendeel/glue-transfer compliance is omitted; this is not a proven conservative stiffness bound.

cassette_cases.glueline_demand_scope: Unnotched-section nominal demand distributed over five full web contacts. It does not represent peak glue demand at half-laps, cutouts, end grips or load introduction.
cassette_cases.allowable_strength_comparison: None: actual ply, adhesive, grain and moisture/temperature durability remain unqualified.

distributed150kg_case.description: 150kg distributed among8slats and2equal spans each; no single-slat concentration

slats.scope: Slat members only. No credit here for comb/floor welds, pan plate, shims, bearer joints or the full table. Slats are plasma supports, not the routing/clamping bed.
requirements: Verify actual thickness>=1.8mm and material grade
Qualify actual comb contacts, slot clearance and weld/standoff load path
Check local edge bearing and concentrated workpiece placement
No generic mild-steel yield allowable or floor strength is asserted

cabinet_front_strip.load_path: Cabinet stands on its own four floor columns. Rear links resist tipping only, not normal gravity. No cabinet ballast credit to main frame.
requirements: Do not treat thin skin or blind rivets as perfect buckling restraints without joint/lateral-restraint qualification
Verify actual25x25x3 angle material, cut edge radius/quality and remaining weak strip
Verify floor contact/levelling, shelf/skin rivet bearing, local wall buckling and actual loaded cabinet mass
Proof rear anti-tip links and rivets independently; they must not suspend cabinet gravity loads
cabinet_front_strip.scope: Ideal straight elastic strip sensitivities only. No allowable load rating, imperfection, local plate or complete cabinet stability calculation is asserted.

front_transfer_notches.status: Local notch/profile-lip/pan-seat/contact qualification remains required; analytical unrelieved arm reference is not a notch-strength proof.

skin_stock_orientation.nest: 2×932 along2440 and4×257 across1220;4mm gaps and2mm outer trim fit1872×1044.
skin_stock_orientation.requirement: Put the declared/measured stronger plywood bending direction along932. Generic plywood labeling or a rotated nest does not establishE4000.

qualification_required: Supplier or coupon bending/shear data in the actual grain direction and moisture condition
Continuous bonded web-to-skin interfaces, cure, sealing and repeated load/temperature durability
Static100N relative work-surface deflection tests at midpoint, near pockets and panel seams
Joint/ledger/contact compliance measured against the remaining ideal budget, not assumed zero
Track lip, fastener, backing-block, compression-tube and skin-pull-through proof under actual clamp preload
Local hand-grip and finger-pocket stress concentrations and repeated handling
Front transfer-notch profile lip/contact behavior and three-station front-ledger anti-roll response
Front cabinet stripped-angle segments, side-skin/rivet lateral restraint, floor contacts and rear anti-tip links
Positive slat-to-comb-to-pan/frame load path and cold load test before assigning a table workpiece rating
proof_case_scope: 300N values are linear sensitivity results, not an approved machining load or an asserted nondestructive proof procedure.
non_coverage: Owned gantry, rails, drive modules, screw lead, Z/spindle/tooling
Track/clamp hardware strength and exact supplier profiles
Pan floor/weld/comb system capacity and thermal distortion
Transfer sweep, water flow, electrical interface and protected-storage temperatures
